## Use case

Where will this poster be used?

Examples: WeChat group, community bulletin board, printed notice, urgent road rescue, found-owner notice.

## Required information hierarchy

What must be most visible?

- status:
- location:
- contact:
- reward:
- risk:
- photo:

## Reference

Attach a sketch, screenshot, or written layout description if available.

## Safety requirements

- [ ] Shows anti-scam warning.
- [ ] Shows short ID or stable public page link.
- [ ] Does not hide current status.
- [ ] Works on mobile.
